Reflection:
The bookmarks bar is not currently visible. To create a new folder on it, I first need to display the bookmarks bar by toggling it with Ctrl+Shift+B.

```python
import pyautogui, time
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 'b')
```

The bookmarks bar should now be visible under the address bar. To add a new folder, I need to open its context menu by right-clicking on an empty spot on the bar.

```python
import pyautogui, time
time.sleep(0.5)
# Right-click on an empty area of the bookmarks bar (approximately x=400, y=142)
pyautogui.click(400, 142, button='right')
```

Reflection:
The context menu for the address bar is open (showing “Undo”, “Cut”, etc.). I need to close it and then right-click on a blank spot just below the address bar (around y=160) to open the bookmarks-bar context menu.

```python
import pyautogui, time
time.sleep(0.5)
# Close the address‐bar context menu
pyautogui.press('esc')
time.sleep(0.2)
# Right‐click on empty area of the bookmarks bar (around x=400, y=160)
pyautogui.click(400, 160, button='right')
```
